calls.statement:
SELECT 'prod' k, CAST(product_key AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(sku AS VARCHAR) b, product_name c, category d, subcategory e, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) f, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) g, CAST(delisted_on AS VARCHAR) h FROM dim_product WHERE sku=101624 OR product_name ILIKE '%Kaakkuri%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR), CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), store_name, city, region, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR), CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR), CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Kaakkuri%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'week', CAST(fiscal_week AS VARCHAR), fiscal_year, CAST(fiscal_week_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(fiscal_week_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(calendar_date AS VARCHAR), '', '', '' FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date IN (DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-01')

calls.statement:
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, s.store_id, f.product_key, p.sku, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no

WITH d AS (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week=22)
SELECT 131 AS store_id, 'Oulu Kaakkuri' AS store_name, 101624 AS sku, 'Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251' AS product_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 22 AS fiscal_week, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_line_ids,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale_date,
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=r.product_key, d WHERE s2.store_id=131 AND p2.sku=101624 AND r.return_date BETWEEN d.d0 AND d.d1) AS units_returned_in_week
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id=131
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key AND p.sku=101624, d
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN d.d0 AND d.d1
